explication: This tree is the browser-side JavaScript of Znuny, a ticket-management system. Agent workflows cover ticket search, viewing, and actions; customers use a separate ticket portal. Administration configures system features and web-service integrations, while shared modules provide initialization, UI behavior, and AJAX requests. The sampled sources confirm AJAX dispatch from package administration and web-service dynamic fields. Other capabilities are represented from their module names in the tree; their exact runtime wiring is not established by the excerpts.
